english.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone is frightened extremely badly, literally ‘scared to death’.

examples.english: That lightning just now really did terrify me.
examples.traditional: 啱啱嗰下閃電真係嚇死我喇。
examples.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 go2 haa6 sim2 din6 zan1 hai6 haak3 sei2 ngo5 laa3
